items.prompt: A Soviet hotel lobby in the early 1980s. In a corner stands a coin-operated arcade racing machine with two small steering wheels and a glowing screen showing a winding road. A father and a small child, seen from behind, each grip a wheel. Potted palm, worn carpet.

alt.ru: Гостиничное фойе начала 1980-х: в углу игровой автомат с двумя рулями и светящимся экраном, отец и маленький ребёнок со спины держатся за рули.
alt.en: A hotel lobby in the early 1980s: an arcade machine with two steering wheels and a glowing screen, a father and a small child at the wheels, seen from behind.
alt.pt: Um átrio de hotel no início dos anos 80: uma máquina de jogos com dois volantes e um ecrã aceso, pai e filho pequeno de costas aos volantes.
alt.es: Un vestíbulo de hotel a principios de los ochenta: una máquina recreativa con dos volantes y una pantalla encendida, un padre y un niño pequeño de espaldas a los mandos.
